column1: # The game's data that means "the one player". The game was built with one of each, so any function touching these does the
# wrong thing for player 2 unless the host's helper has theirs in. `ed needs ADDR` lists which of these a function reaches.
# kind (r13, abs, call), where, size, what it is, the host helper that handles it. Every row is from runtime/host/hle.c.

column4: main: the main character's node. fn93 takes from it
the pad routine's state (input focus -23552, -23556 are in it)
busy: the play hold's word. One per game: both players' holds share it
column5: coop_no_pause, coop_busy_ask, coop_busy_ask_answer with split_busy_allows (the stayer's room plays on through the other's door)

column4: hold word; also zones on (0x8019C088, fn26, a scene): a look with them off clears the looker's inside words (0x80134BE8)
